findings: The 2026-08-23 remediation removes the T3 and Woodies-exit substitutions, implements managed TP1/runner behavior, uses UTC rollover, wires the card loss rails, and keeps management/exits reachable. Those repairs were independently confirmed.

The card's explicit Coral equation is SMMA(P,20, coefficient 0.4). The source calls QM_SMMA with period 20 and exposes no coefficient input or use site, so the declared 0.4 term is discarded and the exact baseline mechanism is still unproven.

OnInit never calls QM_FrameworkDeclareExecutionContract for the approved D1 host and Friday-close contract. Explicit QM_IsNewBar(_Symbol, PERIOD_D1) fixes cadence but does not provide the mandatory fail-closed execution declaration.
Strategy_ConfigValid allows card periods, the one-ATR stop/TP, 50% partial, and 2.0%/2.5%/5.0% loss thresholds to drift or weaken through inputs instead of enforcing the approved ranges and ceilings.

After a successful partial close, QM_TM_MoveSL is unchecked and no durable TP1 latch is recorded. A rejected break-even modification can trigger repeated 50%-of-remainder closes; unsplittable volume receives no fail-closed alternative.
